lenses.reasoning: Confirmed zero auth across all 8 routers + 2 direct endpoints: grep for 'Depends(' returned 0 results. Only CORS middleware (browser-only). Cloud Run is --allow-unauthenticated (cloudbuild.yaml:22). All ~30+ endpoints directly reachable by any HTTP client.

sat_enquiry.py:286 makes paid Diverza API calls consuming real financial credits per query. Attacker can overwrite/delete PAC credentials (emisores.py:54-77) and e.Firma (rfc_validation.py:128-145), or trigger costly batch Cloud Tasks operations. Real financial loss through Diverza credit drain and cloud resource abuse.

Zero defenses at every layer: no auth middleware on FastAPI app (main.py:55), no Depends() on any router, no OIDC, no API keys. Vercel rewrite (vercel.json:5) doesn't inject auth. Cloud Run --allow-unauthenticated. Code self-describes as 'single-user local tool' but deployed to public URL.

batch.py:210-213 — endpoint has zero auth (no Depends, no x-cloudtasks-queuename check unlike pdf.py:107). Cloud Run --allow-unauthenticated. Vercel rewrite (vercel.json:5) proxies /api/* directly. Attacker POSTs arbitrary JSON → gcs_path flows to bucket.blob(gcs_path).download_as_bytes at batch.py:231 and run_analyze_cfdi at batch.py:238.

batch.py:231 — unvalidated GCS download extracts CFDI data (RFCs, totals, dates at batch.py:274-285). batch.py:307 — parsed_result exfiltrated via public Pusher channel. GCS bucket stores Mexican tax documents with legally protected taxpayer IDs.

No x-cloudtasks-queuename check (pdf.py:107-108 has it, batch.py:210-311 doesn't). No OIDC (task_dispatcher.py:80-87 sends no oidc_token). No middleware. Cloud Run --allow-unauthenticated (cloudbuild.yaml:22).
emisores.py:54 POST handler has no Depends/auth check. main.py:103 includes router with no middleware guard. No auth mechanism exists anywhere in backend/app/.

Full credential-injection-to-impersonation chain: POST emisores.py:54 stores credential_token (credentials.py:49-52), sat_enquiry.py:288 retrieves it, sat_enquiry.py:130-131 injects into Diverza API call. No auth on any endpoint in the chain.

emisores.py:54-77 — no Depends, no auth middleware, no API key check. CORS is browser-only. Fernet encryption is transparent at-rest protection, not access control — attacker calls API, server decrypts/encrypts for them.

vercel.json:5 proxies /api/* to Cloud Run making all endpoints same-origin. pdf.py:107-108 guards with only 'x-cloudtasks-queuename' in request.headers — bare presence check. x-cloudtasks-queuename is NOT browser-forbidden (custom x- prefix). Same-origin fetch() preserves custom headers through Vercel rewrite.

generate-pdf runs CPU-intensive WeasyPrint+reportlab via ProcessPoolExecutor (up to 8 workers), uploads to GCS, updates Redis — all billable. No rate limiting. Attacker-controlled xml_b64 feeds into pipeline. Worker-task (batch.py:210, zero auth) adds another CPU-burn surface.

pdf.py:107 only checks header PRESENCE. vercel.json:5 makes endpoints same-origin. Cloud Run --allow-unauthenticated. No CSP in frontend (vercel.json has no headers config, index.html has no CSP). No OIDC, no IP whitelist, no request signing.

Endpoint at sat_enquiry.py:312 has no auth dependency. Batch handler calls get_cred() at line 178 to fetch credential_token, sends to Diverza at line 155. No rate limiting. Attack path confirmed: unauthenticated POST → Excel parse → credential retrieval → Diverza API calls with victim's token.

Each Excel row triggers paid Diverza SAT enquiry (sat_enquiry.py:150) using victim's stored credentials (sat_enquiry.py:178). Diverza is a commercial PAC charging per API call. Financial loss is real.
No auth at endpoint (sat_enquiry.py:312 — no Depends), no app-level auth middleware (main.py:90-100), no infra-level auth (cloudbuild.yaml:22 — --allow-unauthenticated), no rate limiting.
